sentences.text: Counsel for Petitioner :- Vinod Kumar Pandey

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents and perused the record.

Learned AGA, on instructions, states that during course of investigation, sections 376, 326, 394 IPC are dropped and charge sheet is submitted against the petitioners under Sections 504, 506, 498A IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act.

At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners prays that they may be granted benefit of Section 41-A of Cr.P.C. as the offences in which the charge sheet has been submitted are punishable for the Shivam Singh And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home U.P. ... on 30 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124250537/
1 imprisonment upto seven years.

sentences.text:
Accordingly, we dispose of this petition with the direction to the police authorities concerned to follow the mandate of Section 41A Cr.P.C. and also the directions issued by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, reported in (2014) 8 SCC 273.
.
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Vivek Chaudhary,J.) Order Date :- 30.9.2024
